pages.text: The Circle did not cross the veil alone. They brought a protector: $(l)Morvane$(), a king who had sworn to guard them until the last of them was safe.$(br2)None of them were. He is still keeping his oath.
pages.title: The Revenant Castle

pages.text: His castle drifts on its own island: a curtain wall, four round towers, a gatehouse and a great keep.$(br2)Its gates are $(l)portcullises$(). Pull the $(l)lever$() on the ground beside one to raise it, and again to drop it. There is a lever on each side.

$(li)$(l)Ground:$() the great hall$(li)$(l)Upper floor:$() library and armory$(li)$(l)Top:$() the throne room$(li)$(l)Beneath:$() the dungeon, by a ladder before the hearth$(li)$(l)North-east tower:$() the Castellan
pages.title: Floor by Floor

pages.text: $(l)Sir Aldric, the Castellan$(), keeps Morvane's keys at the top of the north-east tower.$(li)His $(l)chain$() drags you to him$(li)His $(l)shield$() bashes you back, and turns most of an arrow aside$(li)At half strength he calls two Revenant Guard archers$(br2)He carries the $(l)Treasury Key$().
pages.title: The Castellan

pages.text: The treasury is a sealed vault behind the throne, walled in $(l)Warded Stone$() that nothing can break. Right-click its $(l)Vault Door$() with the key. Inside: netherite, diamonds, gold, and a Lost Page.

$(l)Morvane$() fights with his blade, not with spells.$(li)Too close, and he $(l)cleaves$()$(li)Too far, and he $(l)leaps$() and slams down$(li)Hurt him, and his guard rise$(li)At the end, rings of $(l)soul fire$() race across the floor. $(l)Jump$() them
pages.title: Morvane, the Revenant King

pages.text: His blade: stronger than netherite, and every hit restores $(l)3 mana$(). Breaking his oath for the first time also brings back $(l)10 Knowledge$().
